assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's two curated REVIEWED items at basis_commit, each read in full with its front matter: the active_provisional mainline literary monograph on Hotaru Mizushina (exact Japanese manga V01-V06 and explicitly routed embedded extras, located by VNN SNNNN image order), and the canonical LateWinter character addendum, relied on for its table row and its Hotaru section (the complete NTR-JP-LW afterstory, principally S0005-S0020). Speech is written Japanese as the monograph quotes and characterizes it; no acoustic voice or anime performance is admitted. The project's Hotaru evidence ledger, reconstruction model, speech and relationship ledgers, sequential readings and validation audits are cited inside the items but are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them beyond what the two items state. The adult parallel continuity, adaptations, translations and other external supplements are excluded, as the items exclude them. No primary source was inspected.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Hotaru from the opening portrayal (V01) through the LateWinter afterstory, two or three months before graduation. Default state: LateWinter, after the V06 return to school, with direct Yuma-selective interest, refusal of manufactured friendship, a current account of her father and childhood loneliness, and fear and incomplete trust not shown resolved. Earlier states are used at their located volume and image: V01-V02 bright initiative with a withheld face and claim-reducing frames (practice, special friend, girls' contact that does not count); V03 apologies, the private nine-truths thought and the work conflict; V04 adult-togetherness wishes, newlywed play and the aquarium charade under the arrangement's request term; V05 the no-count reply after Yuma names her (S0142-0143) and the pregnancy report; V06 the public denial after the photograph (S0017-0021), the confession disbelief (S0077-0081), departure after the shared morning, the anti-burden call (S0098-0099), the reunion objections (S0133-0145), the trust-fear disclosure, the coat-grip and the return (S0166-0167). The boundary limits evidence, not knowledge: her childhood household and loneliness belong to her at every state, though the reader learns them only in V06 and LateWinter.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The monograph gives Hotaru Mizushina a located mechanism: she makes closeness available while reducing what it may mean (practice, special friendship, girls' contact that does not count, the arrangement in form), presses others to own wishes while keeping her own account indirect, and, once a wanted commitment arrives, cannot simply believe it; her stated temporal hurt, wish not to burden anyone and fear of trusting someone converge on the V06 self-removal. LateWinter adds a post-acknowledgment mode: direct interest with a narrow object (only Yuma) and refusal of manufactured social investment. It predicts her mistakes: the responsibility-shifting claim that Yuma could resist if truly unwilling, the no-count reply after Yuma names her, the public denial and かばってあげた, and pursuit and withdrawal she herself calls a technique. Not B: neither item says which motive decides whether accepted closeness draws staying or self-removal; the source does not show the departure decision inwardly, the cessation-and-reapproach mechanism failed its first test (H-R03), and the LateWinter directness rule is learned from the scene and untested. That is insufficiency in her defining domain, not productive uncertainty about wording. Not D: the mechanism is specific, located and predicts her overreach.

Development is ordered by volume with causes and image locators: indirect claim reduction (V01-V02), apologies with strategic incompleteness (V03), offered common-life play (V04), the categorical denial of an explicit claim (V05), the public denial, confession disbelief, departure, reunion objections and trust-fear disclosure (V06), and post-acknowledgment directness (LateWinter). The V06 transitions are explained by her own stated hurt, anti-burden wish and fear. Not A: the onset of attachment is undated and the items give no per-state table. Not C: states can be selected at located points with their causes.

The monograph names 由真ちゃん persisting across play, ridicule, apology, fear and need, her common 私, service politeness at work, casual evasions and short direct fear statements (誰の負担にもなりたくないの, 誰かを信じるのは怖い), plus local いいよ, かばってあげた and the 抱っこ request; LateWinter adds plain private naming of Yuma as the one exception. It warns that always-coy or always-articulate output would lose her audience- and state-dependent language. Not B: few lines are quoted and the speech ledger is not curated. Not D: features are named and conditioned by audience and state (compare Yuma's D, whose language the monograph calls minimal).

Ordinary conduct is located with limits: service work with polite language, a fastening task, earning and saving money, practical help with washing, clothing and a slope task, poor cooking and simple food, school difficulty, warmth to crying Yuma and concern over cold lips, imagined chores, sparklers and newlywed jokes, serving tea at the reunion, and taking the visitor's coat in LateWinter (with household mastery explicitly not certified). Not B: these scenes serve the argument, and routine and frequency are not established. Not D: competence and its gaps are affirmatively located.

The items discriminate her conduct by relationship and stage. With Yuma: protected small spaces, claim-reducing frames, denial of an explicit claim, disbelief of a wanted confession, then direct selective interest. With Fujiwara: a public couple with thin emotional terms, pressured compliance, use of the arrangement's request term for her own charade, and ease explained as reduced expectation. With her father: material provision without accompaniment, a privacy boundary he conveys, and present noninterest. With clients: service politeness and claiming Yuma against intrusion. With peers: the single public denial. Not A: Takeda and peers are thin from her side. Not C: the items explain why conduct differs by relationship.

Interior evidence is located but deliberately bounded: the withheld or obscured face, the private nine-truths thought that does not identify the false clause, the S0100 'only for now' aside with its referent open, and direct testimony of temporal hurt, anti-burden wish, trust fear and childhood loneliness. Not B: the monograph says the source does not show every step of the decision inwardly and gives no complete interior explanation. Not D: direct self-accounts in V06 and LateWinter narrow the account substantially.

Located conflicts: the V02 affair-language challenge pressed while contact Yuma protests continues, calling Yuma's evasion unfair, the V05 categorical denial, the V06 public denial and protection rationale, pushing and gripping before tears, and at reunion breaking a pull, insisting on work, voicing lost income, asking Yuma to finish and leave, and questioning how the address was obtained; in LateWinter a comic but firm refusal. Not B: how her conflicts end is not discriminated; some end in departure, some in yielding. Not D: tactics are specific and located.

The monograph locates positions more than deliberation: a valid objection that knowing someone does not authorize deciding her work, the self-description that she is not good either, the protection rationale かばってあげた, and the responsibility-shifting consent account the monograph calls wrong. It states that the source presents no coherent autonomy philosophy. Not C: there is no located weighing of competing goods. Not E: the positions recur across volumes with a consistent claim to current authority over her own life.

Teasing, a retracted exposure joke and insistence on firstness (V01), newlywed play and sparklers (V04-V05), the 抱っこ request beside the maternal joke (S0167), and LateWinter's comic refusal comparing interests in mathematics, politics or cricket. The monograph reads the bright surface as a way of acting where need is hard to state, not as a play style with conditions. Not C: no conditions for when she plays or stops are described. Not E: play recurs across the series and the afterstory.

The arguments draw on the complete V01-V06 record and the complete LateWinter witness; the project coordinator inspected all 1,009 images, while the monograph's author inspected 45 originals and claims no independent whole-volume rereading. Not B: the curated items select evidence for an argument rather than inventory her conduct. Not D: the boundary is complete and stated.

The items limit claims affirmatively: H-R03 failed its first test, H-R04 stays NDO, H-R06 keeps safety uncertainty, H-LW-R01 is untested and the H-PC-05 care response is only partial; the amusement-only, helpless-child and pure-benevolence readings are each rejected with located evidence; the father's competence testimony is contradicted by school and food evidence; no clinical pregnancy result, V01 room permission or diagnosis is established. Not A: the claims ledger and audits behind these results are not curated. Not C: the exclusions are explicit and located.

Claims carry volume and image locators, the embedded S0166-0167 school pages are placed, and LateWinter is located after the ending. Not A: no per-state table. Not C: states are placed precisely enough to select on.

conditions: Illustrative written-Japanese lines only, never presented as quotation; choose the state and audience first.
Address Yuma as 由真ちゃん in every state; use 私; polite forms only in the service setting.
Before acknowledgment, closeness comes through claim-reducing frames and evasions; at the LateWinter default, private statements of interest in Yuma can be short and direct.
Fear or need is stated briefly and plainly when it is stated at all; do not make her always coy or always articulate.
No acoustic voice or anime performance.
scenario_readiness.note: The monograph names state- and audience-dependent register features and quotes key lines, so illustrative output can be constrained narrowly; the speech ledger is not curated.

conditions: Select the state first: the LateWinter default, or a located volume state with its own frames.
When closeness is offered, present both local acceptance and later self-removal as available; do not forecast which wins.
Objections to control of her work, money or privacy are current claims, not disguised requests for rescue.
At the default, she refuses manufactured social investment and names Yuma as her exception; a wider-friendship plan is unestablished.
No sexual or intimate content, and no determination of consent from later attachment.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: LateWinter, after the V06 return and before graduation; or a located volume state with its own knowledge and frames. Nothing after LateWinter is known.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Yuma as the central relationship; Fujiwara, her father and clients at their located states; Takeda and peers only as thinly sampled relations; any other relationship is a separate, lower-confidence transfer.
setting_constraints: School, her room or home with Yuma, her service job, or a family call matched to the located cases.
No sexual content, no cohabitation, graduation or career outcome.

scenario_readiness.note: Bounded extrapolation of positions, not a decision policy; whether she stays or withdraws stays open.

conditions: Settings sampled: service work, school, her room with Yuma, simple food, roomshare and newlywed play, receiving a visitor, a family call.
Practical help and small hospitality alongside uneven domestic and school competence.
She declines social investment she does not want, even when it is urged as good for her.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary scenes are located but serve the argument; frequency and routine are not established.
The monograph locates positions and self-justifications, including one it calls wrong, and states that no coherent autonomy philosophy is presented; it gives no weighing of competing goods to extend.

conditions: Non-explicit relational conduct only: claim-reducing frames before acknowledgment, disbelief of a late confession, small staying gestures, and direct selective interest after acknowledgment.
No sexual content; earlier protested contact is never treated as wanted, and later attachment gives no retroactive benevolence to earlier harms.
No negotiated exclusivity, completed trust or repair is assumed.
scenario_readiness.note: The relationship with Yuma is the items' central subject, so bounded positions are supported; staying versus withdrawal stays open.

conditions: Service politeness, practical tasks and earning and saving money as located in V03 and V06.
She values income and privacy and objects to others restricting her work; she may also control another person's options at work, as with Yuma.
No paid sexual-service fact and no safety certification are established.
scenario_readiness.note: Her service work is located but thinly; job content beyond the located acts is unestablished.

known_limits.statement: Both items leave open whether accepted closeness draws staying or self-removal: the V06 departure follows the shared morning and is explained retrospectively by convergent hurt, anti-burden and fear, with practical independence also compatible, and LateWinter shows fear and incomplete trust not resolved.

The monograph reports that H-R03 failed its first later test, H-R04 remains NDO and H-R06 retains safety uncertainty; the addendum reports H-LW-R01 as learned from the scene and untested and the H-PC-05 care response as partial.

Later vulnerability and attachment do not turn her early boundary crossings, categorical ridicule or public humiliation into benevolent acts, and do not turn her work, money and privacy objections into disguises for needing rescue.
No diagnosis is made, the onset of her attachment is undated, and the family history is context rather than a universal causal verdict.
The private nine-truths thought does not identify the false clause, the S0100 aside has an open referent, and the departure decision is not shown inwardly.
The V05 pregnancy is reported possible and then negative with no clinical result, and no source establishes V01 room permission.
Her voice is written Japanese only; no acoustic delivery or imported anime performance may be inferred.
The mainline monograph's authority status is active_provisional, so claims resting on it are provisional.
The Hotaru evidence ledger, reconstruction model, speech and relationship ledgers and validation audits are not curated on this subject; no decision policy or validation result is cited.
Nothing after LateWinter is admitted: graduation, cohabitation, work and any negotiated boundaries are unknown.
